title: Hot Water System Replacement quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Remove and dispose of existing 125L electric hot water system (Rheem 125L). Supply and install new 160L electric hot water system (Rheem Stellar 160L 3.6kW). Include new tempering valve (RMC HT50), pressure and temperature relief valve (PTR valve), and isolation valves. Connect to existing power supply and water lines. Replace approximately 2 metres of copper pipework with new 20mm copper, including necessary fittings (elbows, reducers). Insulate new pipework using Armaflex pipe insulation. Test and commission system. Clean up site.
workingDetail: Hot water unit (gas, electric, or heat pump), Tempering valve, Pipe fittings and connections, Gas fittings (if applicable)
